reviews.title: Used to be good!
reviews.text: I really liked using this app and have been for years until recently when a pop up about my list being edited comes up multiple times and is annoying. I don’t share the list with anyone else so there should t be an issue. Bi deleted it and restarted it and still nothing. Please fix!

reviews.title: Was My Favorite But I Had to Delete It
reviews.text: This was my favorite grocery app because of the yellow notepad theme and because it's simple but the items can be easily rearranged. Now however I repeatedly get the pop up message saying the list has been edited or deleted on another device. I've tried everything to make it stop! I just tried it again and it's still happening after over a year of not using it. So frustrating. I also paid for ad free and the theme I like. I hope they fix it!!

reviews.title: Use to be good
reviews.text: I have used this app for years and never had problems. But now it’s constantly popping up saying the list was changed on another device. I only have one device!
